calibration.title: Predicted vs observed first-try success
calibration.help: First attempts are grouped by the model's predicted probability. Points below the diagonal mean the model was over-confident (items were harder than it thought); above means under-confident.

calibration.none: Nothing flagged yet (needs at least 15 first attempts on a skill).

count.off_by_one.name: Counting slip (one too many or few)
count.off_by_one.tip: Count each hop out loud, one at a time.

add.dropped_ten.name: Dropped the ten when bridging 10
add.dropped_ten.tip: When you pass 10, keep the ten!

add.no_carry.name: Forgot to carry
add.no_carry.tip: When a column makes 10 or more, carry the ten to the next column.

add.carry_concat.name: Wrote the whole column sum instead of carrying
add.carry_concat.tip: Write only the ones; carry the ten.

sub.count_includes_start.name: Counted the starting number when counting back
sub.count_includes_start.tip: Don't count the number you start on — count the hops.

sub.smaller_from_larger.name: Subtracted the smaller digit from the larger in each column
sub.smaller_from_larger.tip: If the top digit is smaller, borrow a ten first.

sub.borrow_no_decrement.name: Borrowed without reducing the next column
sub.borrow_no_decrement.tip: When you borrow a ten, the next column goes down by one.

pv.reversal.name: Swapped tens and ones
pv.reversal.tip: Tens come first: big hops of 10, then small hops.

pv.concat.name: Wrote digits side by side without regrouping
pv.concat.tip: Ten ones make a new ten.

pv.missing_zero.name: Left out a zero place holder
pv.missing_zero.tip: An empty place still needs a 0.

bonds.gave_total.name: Gave the total instead of the missing part
bonds.gave_total.tip: Count only the hops to the flag.

bonds.echo.name: Repeated the given number
bonds.echo.tip: Count the hops between you and the flag.

mul.added.name: Added instead of multiplying
mul.added.tip: Times means equal hops, again and again.

mul.adjacent_fact.name: Neighbouring fact (one group too many or few)
mul.adjacent_fact.tip: Count the groups — one more or one less changes the answer.

mul.zeros.name: Wrong number of zeros
mul.zeros.tip: Count the zeros in both numbers.

mul.no_carry.name: Forgot to carry in multiplication
mul.no_carry.tip: Split the number into tens and ones, then add the parts.

mul.partial_products_missing.name: Multiplied tens by tens and ones by ones only

div.subtracted.name: Subtracted instead of dividing
div.subtracted.tip: Count how many equal hops reach the flag.

div.off_by_one.name: One hop too many or few

int.sign_error.name: Right size, wrong sign
int.sign_error.tip: Check which side of 0 you end up on.

int.sub_neg_as_sub.name: Treated minus a negative as minus
int.sub_neg_as_sub.tip: Minus a negative means hop right.

int.added_magnitudes.name: Added the sizes and kept the minus
int.added_magnitudes.tip: From a negative number, adding moves you right, toward 0.

pilot.title: Pilot readout
pilot.help: The two-week pilot measures, computed from the play log on this device. Compare them week by week rather than judging by one number.

pilot.calNone: Shown after 15 first tries on a skill.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.help: Strategy (Band A): how often an answer used the hop buttons (counting on) rather than a direct tap on the number, and the median time of correct answers in the earlier half, then the later half. Fewer hops and faster answers mean a fact is moving from counting to memory.

clips.missing: Recording checklist: {n, plural, one {# clip} other {# clips}} to go
clips.how: Record each clip as an MP3 with the name shown and put it in {dir}. Then run npm run gen:clips (npm run build does it too).

storage.otherTab: Hopa is already open in another browser tab or window, so nothing is saved here. Close Hopa there, then reload this page.
storage.idbUsed: Answer history: {kb} KB in the browser's database, with room for years of play.
storage.localOnly: The browser's database is not available, so the answer history stays in the storage above; when it fills up, the oldest months are summarised.
storage.historyHidden: Older answer history could not be opened this time. Nothing is lost: reload the page. A backup made now would not include it.
storage.persisted: Protected: the browser will not clear this data to free up space.
storage.notPersisted: The browser may clear this data if the device runs low on space.
storage.keepSafeDenied: The browser has not allowed it yet. Adding Hopa to the Home Screen and regular backups also keep the data safe.
